brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Three keyhole hangers on consistent rear face (slot 1): accessory:0#0,0#1 at 0,0,0, accessory:0#1,0#1 at 1,0,0, accessory:0#2,0#1 at 2,0,0. Linear 3-piece cluster provides stable wall plane with multiple screw points; check_build meshClash=clear.

Three hook plates on opposite front face (slot 4): accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4, accessory:0#2,0#4. Each hex-acc-hook plate carries two hooks side-by-side = 6 hooks total across 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 2,0,0 for pliers, wrenches, etc.; meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell linear tool rack (piece:0,0,0;full, 1,0,0;full, 2,0,0;full with 2 jointBolts). Rear face (slot 1) has 3x hex-acc-keyhole hangers for wall mounting; front face (slot 4) has 3x hex-acc-hook plates providing 6 hooks for hand tools. check_build ok, meshClash clear, no loose bodies.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
